QUOTE: It calls `client.createPost` again. This is a fresh POST, which the server treats as a new post... On failure, the same branch rules apply again: server-error cases remove the post, and anything else marks it failed again.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer describes a single new createPost call on retry and states that failure either removes the post (the server-error cases) or marks it failed again. It doesn't explicitly say "no loop or backoff", but it does say there are no automatic retries and that retry is a single user-triggered call.
